description: as cfd_2d_dambreak with the free surface and the momentum of the water from the PIC particles, single phase (F 81 1, since patch 0009; before: phase 1, the momentum Eulerian): APIC velocities to the faces next to the water, no air in the momentum, p = 0 at the free surface by the ghost fluid method, the velocity of the water extended into the air after each projection, spray more than 2 cells away from the water ballistic
covers: pic_gfm: the Poisson matrix and the gradients of the ghost fluid method (poisson_pcorr, pjm_corr)
pic_f_extend: air_velocity, the extension next to the water
pic_f_flip: step_begin and g2p of the single phase
pic_f_phi: water fraction, table of the flat surface, band, redistance; density and viscosity of the water
